title: festuca camusiana
intro: Festuca camusiana, commonly known as mountain fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is known to have various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca camusiana include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which make it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis, coughs, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
